notes.title: Patch 1.11: The Boogieman Cometh!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/b7906bcb7d4808f3077f1927f5c65458605fc6fd.png

Now Available - Boogieman (Poltergeist)

Last June, we not only celebrated Ghostbusters Day, we celebrated the 40th Anniversary! And part of that celebration was running a contest where YOU, the community, could choose a Ghost to be part of Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed!

It was a tight match, but in the end, The Boogieman was the victor! We're happy to announce that TODAY, with the release of Patch 1.11.0, Boogieman is HERE and he's already terrifying all the innocent civvies!

Go forth and bust!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/fd3dbcf227875cb0aabb26c5a669d8b960bc4a7f.jpg
There are many things that go bump in the night, but none are as infamous as the Boogieman himself! He feasts on fear and plagues children with his horrid, nightmarish visage!

Having fought the Ghostbusters on multiple occasions, he's quite experienced with their tactics and trinkets. More importantly, he's back to show just how tantalizingly terrible he can be to this new generation of Busters!

notes.title: Patch 1.10.0: Double Trouble
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/aabc2e3e369ec98ea144f1adfe266ed460f2b97a.jpg
Patch 1.10.0 is here, just in time for the busy season at the Firehouse! And one job in particular has got the phone ringing off the hook. Reports are coming in that the S.C.Y. County Courthouse is currently being haunted by not one, but two ghosts! Suit up, Busters, and remember to work together! As this one may require some... extra elbow grease.

Read the Patch Notes for Patch 1.10.0, or check out the highlights below!

Read the Patch Notes

New Bounty - The Scoleri Brothers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/b00ce1d54c588911e07065569070c5d489def40c.jpg
The Scoleri Brothers, originally tried for murder and sentenced to the electric chair in 1948, are back with a vengeance! They're haunting the S.C.Y. County Courthouse and terrorizing innocent civilians, and it's up to you and your fellow Busters to restore order in the court! Completing this first-ever "double-Ghost" bounty will unlock Tony and Nunzio Scoleri in your Ghost roster!

The Scoleri Brothers bounty is available after completing the Samhain bounty.

New Gear Shells - Zeddemore
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/26e63611d145681a3ecfbf81725577cb3580f280.jpg
Ghostbusters Headquarters went from being out of commission to being the booming operation it is today, thanks to Winston's business savvy. The innovation didn't stop with the Firehouse, as today we present to you these sleek and modern new designs for your Particle Thrower and Proton Pack!

The Zeddemore Gear Shells are unlockable via contracts.

Balance Changes
We’re shaking up the meta! 

Tons of Ghost and Buster stats have been tweaked and changed to make gameplay feel smoother, snappier, and more rewarding. Our intentions behind this update is for both Ghosts and Busters to have a wider variety of tools and options to engage with each other. Read the Patch Notes for the full rundown of changes!

Hop into a match and give us feedback on how these changes feel to you on Discord or on our Socials!

Twitch Drops
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/950191dc13967d647ae1b541561733884cda203f.jpg
The Ghosts have been running rampant, and this special batch of Twitch Drops reflects that, as we are releasing FOUR BUNDLES of Necro Skins! That is a backlog of the first three bundles, with the brand new Necropossessor Skins added!

Details and instructions here!

Drops active between Monday, October 21st at 10:00AM PT through Monday, November 4th at 11:59PM PT.

[hr][/hr]
A big THANK YOU to our players, and a happy haunting (or Busting) to all! We hope you enjoy our events this season, and that you'll join us in the Discord or on our Socials as we celebrate!

The Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed Team

notes.title: Patch 1.8.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/9649de9a387c61e1512a1790de1f3fc5fd37686c.png

New Overlord Variant

 Garraka

From Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire, Garraka joins the ranks of the Overlords to bring upon the death chill in Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed. To unlock Garraka, you’ll have to defeat him in an icy bounty in Galway Station!

“Spine-chilling” is a blistering understatement when describing the cold malevolence that exudes from Garraka, a formidable icy overlord. One look into his cold, soulless eyes will make you wish you never crossed paths, and that’s not even taking into account the baleful ice he can summon with his tremendous psychokinetic energy. Not even the nuclear space heaters strapped to the Ghostbusters’ backs can keep them warm for long.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/f732754caa1ee3694dc0597b38da0ce881e923b5.jpg

Now Replayable

 Samhain Boss Fight

You asked for it! Replay and relive your fight against eternal night. Players who have defeated Samhain will now have the option to challenge the Ghost of Halloween as many times as they’d like. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/09c0730a22104329e50ee944f39e249bf0699539.jpg

New Gear Shells

Modern Age Gear Shells

Changes and Fixes

 Fixed an issue where Watcher Ghost Types were not available in Ghost Bounties
 Fixed an issue where Rifts could become untargetable after being placed in certain objects
 Fixed an issue where Overlords could place Catalysts on top of the whale in Whitestone Museum
 Fixed an issue where Overlord Types were able to place Rift Catalysts outside of bounds on certain maps
 Fixed an issue where turning off the setting “Software Cursor Rendering” would cause the reticle to disappear during the Possessor’s Terrorizing Possession minigame.
 Fixed an issue where on the Nintendo Switch, Gear and Ghost levels would display as Level 1 after re-entering the game while playing fully offline 
 Fixed an issue where Gravebringer’s Ossifying Lance roots VFX could float in the air if fired at a Suspended Buster
 Fixed an issue where Busters couldn’t move if they were clearing slime while Suspended and then struck by Gravebringer’s Ossifying Lance
 Fixed an issue where Busters could not free themselves if hit by Gravebringer’s Ossifying Lance while using certain emotes
 Fixed an issue where Gravebring could lock themselves out of their abilities if they used Ossifying Lance and Sabotaged a Buster’s pack at the same time
 Fixed an issue where Infernal could not use abilities after creating a Darkness Orb and sabotaging a Buster’s Proton Pack at the same time
 Fixed an issue where while a Buster revived their teammate, if that teammate disconnected, the Buster could lose control of their camera
 Fixed an issue where after watching a cinematic, the sky outside of the Firehouse would not appear correctly
 Fixed an issue where certain VFX would appear extremely bright after a player joins a match in-progress
 Fixed an issue where Wraith could Haunt objects that contained Rifts in them
 Fixed an issue where Poltergeists could channel their ultimate ability, Overcharge, while possessing an object
 Fixed an issue where the Master Collector trophy was not syncing between PS4 and PS5 accounts
 Fixed an issue where after equipping certain headwear or full outfits, Busters could not select Top, Bottom, and Eyewear in the customization menu

Ghost
